content:
Bharti Enterprises, founded in 1976 by Sunil Bharti Mittal, has evolved from a small manufacturer of bicycle parts to one of India's largest conglomerates. Initially producing bicycle components, it diversified into manufacturing yarn and stainless steel sheets. The company ventured into telecommunications in 1995, launching mobile services under the brand Airtel in Delhi. Bharti Airtel has since become a leading global communications provider with over 600 million customers in 15 countries across India and Africa. The conglomerate also has interests in telecom, digital infrastructure, space communications, financial services, real estate, hospitality, manufacturing, and food processing.

The group offers financial services across India and also serves customers through its processed foods business. The group has growing interests in other areas such as data centres, real estate, space communications, manufacturing and distribution of telecom/IT products.

Bharti Enterprises Limited offers a comprehensive range of products and services including telecommunications, financial services, real estate, hospitality, food and beverage, and renewable energy. Specific products and services include mobile network services, 5G network services, telecom tower infrastructure, commercial real estate development, life insurance products, general insurance products, and food and beverage products. In telecommunications, Bharti Airtel Limited provides high-speed 4G and 5G mobile broadband, digital payments, Airtel Xstream Fiber, and financial services. The company operates across multiple countries including India and Sri Lanka.
